name: Meet the Travellers
description: Both Fjordfall travellers, each with a skinned 24-joint humanoid and nine animation clips. Start here to bring a character into your game.
notes: Each GLB already contains its animations. Game IK, cloth behavior and collision are not included.

name: A rig and nine movements
description: The standalone humanoid hierarchy and full animation pack for idle, walking, jogging, jumping, boats and skating.
notes: Mesh-free files. Use the matching Fjordfall skeleton; other skeletons require retargeting. Root motion and loop seams are not certified.

name: A small procedural landscape
description: Pine, snow pine, cactus and boulder models from SKYBOUND, with vertex colors and source geometry generators in the repository.
notes: Static scenery. Create colliders and placement rules in your game; source generators are MIT, exported media is CC BY 4.0.

name: Six synthesized effects
description: Small original WAV sounds for movement, impacts, destruction and a looping laser hum.
notes: Mono PCM, 22,050 Hz. The laser hum is a loop; the others are one-shots. Preview volume and mix for your game.
